best_hook.why: Elder nobleman jams his cane into Rupert's chest and pins him to the wall while snarling to burn the 'peasant weed'.

best_cliffhanger.why: 'Tomorrow, she stops being a prisoner. She becomes a witch.' The death sentence is set but not yet carried out.

must_promos.why: 'Then call it witchcraft' opens, villains plan to manufacture evidence, buy the jury and hang her, Rupert writes the warrant, cut on 'she becomes a witch'.
Physical cane-pin hook, the plot escalates from hiding the prisoner to using the law, ending as Rupert realises witchcraft is a capital charge.

standalone_risk: Juliana is barely on screen (only the final shot), so a stranger hears villains plotting against an unseen 'she' without knowing who she is, why she is imprisoned, or who the elder nobleman is.
notes: All-villain conspiracy scene; strong stakes but no protagonist confrontation.
